# Human validation of the silver labels (generated by `python -m app.eval.human score`; do not edit)

Annotators: Hoa Reviewer, Phuc. Quadratic-weighted Cohen's κ on the pairs both sides graded.
Decision rule (EVAL.md §2): κ(human, silver) ≥ 0.8 keeps the silver set as the main test set; ≥ 0.6 keeps it as a secondary set; below that, the human labels replace it.
